_doc: Hunters vs Farmers characters and army (docs/hvf-PLAN.md §6, §7). Read by js/sim/modes/hvf/. Speeds m/s, radius m, sight m, damage per hit. `chop` = seconds to cut one tree cell (briar: `chopBriar`). Hunter HP and damage are multiplied by the format's `hunterMult` (rules.json) and grow `perLevel` per level (levels from kills only, H3). The farmer cannot attack. Farmer abilities (`cast` slots Q/W/E): scamper (speed bonus for seconds, cooldown), lieLow (stand still `still` s in tall grass or at a forest edge: seen only within `seen` m until you move), bell (own animals within radius go home). pullUp: channel seconds within range to remove a watchstone or snare. Army (Harvest Hall): scarecrow and crow (a Crow Flock is `flock` crows); `cap` bodies per farmer; Stuffing upgrades scale scarecrow hp and damage.
